I read every message myself. Email [email protected] Studio Grünerløkka, Oslo Replies Within two working days Availability Projects from November Name Email Studio or company What do you need? Brand identity Art direction Packaging Workshop Something else Budget Under €10k €10k to €25k €25k to €50k Over €50k Message Your details are only used to reply to this message. Send message (Before you write) How far ahead do you book? Usually two to three months. I take four or five identity projects a year, so an early message helps even if the start date is loose. What does a typical identity project include? A short strategy phase, the identity itself, a set of key applications and a guidelines file your team can keep using.
